rows.label: qst650331_msg0002
rows.name:
It's hard to meet an adventurer like
you who travels all over Alst, mo.

rows.label: qst650331_msg0003
rows.name:
I'm a courier, but chasing you around
is exhausting, mo.

rows.label: qst650331_msg0004
rows.name:
So I decided to wait here leisurely
for you to come, mo.

rows.label: qst650331_msg0005
rows.name:
I have a delivery for you from
Correl-san in Iyasaki Village, mo.

rows.label: qst650331_msg0006
rows.name:
Correl-san got it from a kid named
Kazuna...

rows.label: qst650331_msg0007
rows.name:
Kazuna got it from a kid named
Martis...

rows.label: qst650331_msg0008
rows.name:
And apparently Martis got it from the
village chief, but...

rows.label: qst650331_msg0009
rows.name:
Anyway, it is a valuable Core Crystal,
so I was told to handle it carefully
and never lose it, mo.

rows.label: qst650331_msg0010
rows.name:
It was kept in a home storehouse, with
instructions to entrust it to someone
who'd do what's right, mo.

rows.label: qst650331_msg0011
rows.name:
So it seems the people of Iyasaki
Village decided to entrust it to you,
mo.

rows.label: qst650331_msg0013
rows.name:
Since it's valuable, I stay put
instead of carrying it around,
reducing the risk of damage or loss.

rows.label: qst650331_msg0014
rows.name: What a perfect courier I am, mo...

rows.label: qst650331_msg0015
rows.name:
This will raise my reputation as a
courier again, mooo.

rows.label: qst650331_msg0016
rows.name:
I want to teach my younger brother the
tricks of the trade too, mooo.
